description.fun: A ghost with no arms or legs whose long hair spreads out like feathered wings. It drifts through the night sky, and eyewitnesses first took it for a giant, very aggressive Misdreavus; some believe it's the ghost of a pterosaur. Designed by Hitoshi Ariga, it may also draw on the Chonchon of Mapuche legend, a sorcerer's head that flies using its ears.
description.guide: A Ghost and Fairy-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Scarlet, said to be either an ancient relative of Misdreavus or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It was designed by Hitoshi Ariga and only appears at night.
description.tagline: A ghostly Misdreavus that flies on its own feathery hair
